label: Caiaphas was high priest when the leaders gathered
statement: The leaders gathered in the court of the high priest 'who was called Caiaphas': Joseph Caiaphas held the high priesthood at the time of the feast.

label: The chief priests and elders plotted to seize and kill Jesus
statement: The chief priests, scribes and elders took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

label: They avoided arresting Jesus during the feast for fear of a riot
statement: They said 'not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people': the authorities feared the Passover crowds.

label: Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper
statement: Jesus stayed in Bethany, at the house of Simon the leper, in the final week.

label: A woman poured very expensive ointment from an alabaster jar on his head
statement: A woman poured very expensive ointment from an alabaster jar on the head of the reclining Jesus - costly perfumed oil in a stone flask.

label: Judas was promised and paid thirty pieces of silver
statement: Judas asked 'what are you willing to give me?', and the chief priests weighed out thirty pieces of silver to him for delivering Jesus.

label: The disciples prepared the Passover on the first day of unleavened bread
statement: On the first day of unleavened bread the disciples prepared the Passover meal in Jerusalem, in a house Jesus designated.

label: Jesus reclined at table with the twelve in the evening
statement: When evening had come, Jesus was reclining at table (the Passover meal posture) with the twelve disciples.

label: They sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives
statement: When they had sung a hymn (the Passover Hallel) they went out to the Mount of Olives.

label: Before the cock crows Peter will deny Jesus three times
statement: Jesus told Peter he would deny him three times that night before the rooster crows - cockcrow used as a time marker of the night.

label: Jesus came with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane
statement: Jesus came with his disciples to a place (chorion, an estate) called Gethsemane across the Kidron, and prayed there.

label: Judas came with a great crowd armed with swords and clubs
statement: Judas came with a great crowd carrying swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people, to seize Jesus.

label: A companion drew his sword and cut off the ear of the high priest’s servant
statement: One of those with Jesus drew his sword (a short Roman-era blade) and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

label: Twelve legions of angels - the legion as a large Roman unit
statement: Jesus said his Father could send more than twelve legions of angels; the legion was the Roman army’s largest unit, numbering thousands of men.

label: Jesus sat daily teaching in the temple
statement: Jesus said he sat daily in the temple teaching, and was not arrested there - public teaching in the temple courts during the festival week.

label: Jesus was led to Caiaphas where the scribes and elders gathered
statement: Those who seized Jesus led him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had gathered for the hearing.

label: Peter followed into the courtyard of the high priest’s house
statement: Peter followed at a distance into the court (courtyard) of the high priest’s house and sat with the officers to see the end.

label: The whole council sought testimony to put Jesus to death
statement: The chief priests, the elders and the whole council (the Sanhedrin) sought testimony against Jesus to put him to death.

label: The Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky
statement: Jesus said they would see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of the sky - Danielic and Enochic Son-of-Man language.

label: The high priest tore his clothing at the alleged blasphemy
statement: The high priest tore his clothing and said "He has spoken blasphemy", and the council declared him worthy of death.

label: Peter’s Galilean accent gave him away
statement: Bystanders said to Peter "your speech makes you known" - his Galilean accent identified him as one of Jesus’ Galilean followers.
